name: iter_move(ranges::cartesian_product_view::iterator)

declarations.code: friend constexpr auto iter_move(const /*iterator*/ &i) noexcept(/* see below */)

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A tuple that contains the result of applying ranges::iter_move to the stored underlying iterators converted to the return type, as described above.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text:
The exception specification is equivalent to the logical AND of the following expressions:

noexcept(ranges::iter_move(std::get<N>(i.current_))) for every integer 0 ≤ N ≤ sizeof...(Vs),
 std::is_nothrow_move_constructible_v<ranges::range_rvalue_reference_t</*maybe-const*/<Const, T>>> for every type T in First, Vs....

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Build a cartesian_product_view over the arrays below, read the first item, and move to the next position.

summary: Let current_ be the underlying tuple of iterators.
